title: The Contemporary writer in the city
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：contemporary　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 contemporary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the athlete wrote of ① a contemporary writer in the city in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② more contemporary than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the contemporary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most contemporary writer in the city anybody in the stadium had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too contemporary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the contemporary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a contemporary record of the time, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as contemporary as the record of the time they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was contemporary or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something contemporary, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite contemporary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the contemporary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, in the rain, she wrote of another contemporary writer in the city in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more contemporary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most contemporary record of the time in the whole stadium, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the contemporary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 当代（前置定语 a contemporary writer in the city：1977 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件当代的作家）
B. adj. 当代／同时代（比较级 more contemporary than：文中两处，一处比城里的作家，一处比预想）
C. adj. 当代／同时代（最高级 the most contemporary：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 当代（表语 too contemporary to do：母亲觉得它太当代，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 同时代（前置定语 a contemporary record of the time：叔叔把整件事称作一桩同时代的记录）
F. adj. 同时代（同级比较 as contemporary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩那个年代的记录相比）
G. adj. 同时代（后置定语 something contemporary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 同时代（受程度副词修饰 quite contemporary：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a contemporary writer in the city
the most contemporary writer in the city anybody
a contemporary record of the time
The most contemporary record of the time in

answers.why: contemporary 意为“当代”，1977 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件当代的作家”，此处作前置定语 a contemporary writer in the city。
contemporary 意为“当代”，此处用比较级 more contemporary than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
contemporary 意为“当代”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说它是体育场里最当代的一件，故用最高级 the most contemporary writer in the city。
contemporary 意为“当代”，母亲认为这件东西“太当代了，谁也用不上”，too contemporary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
contemporary 意为“同时代”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩同时代的记录”，此处作前置定语 a contemporary record of the time。
contemporary 意为“同时代”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩那个年代的记录一样同时代”，同级比较用 as contemporary as。
contemporary 意为“同时代”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“同时代的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something contemporary。
contemporary 意为“同时代”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当同时代”，quite 修饰原级 contemporary。
contemporary 意为“同时代”，1987 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要同时代”，故用比较级 more contemporary than。
contemporary 意为“同时代”，母亲 1989 年说的是“整个体育场里最同时代的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most contemporary record of the time。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件当代的作家。（a contemporary writer in the city）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更当代。（more contemporary than …）
母亲觉得它太当代，谁也用不上。（too contemporary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩同时代的记录。（a contemporary record of the time）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩那个年代的记录一样同时代。（as contemporary as …）
到了 1984 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件同时代的东西。（something contemporary）
answers: In 1977 the athlete wrote of a contemporary writer in the city in the programme.
Everybody said it was more contemporary than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too contemporary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a contemporary record of the time.
He said nobody would call it as contemporary as the record of the time they had once had.
By 1984 the programme asked for nothing but something contemporary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 contemporary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the athlete wrote of a contemporary writer in the city in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most contemporary writer in the city in the stadium, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too contemporary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a contemporary record of the time, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite contemporary, and everybody laughed.
The contemporary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
